scientific_question: Can a frozen mechanism-specific instrument distinguish the principal active-repertoire and recurrence source architectures that currently compete to explain Voynich local/regional recurrence, before any Voynich target statistic is exposed?

sources.name: working_set_only
sources.definition: Frozen WorkingSetV2/base active page+bifolium repertoire with the regional exact R64 channel disabled (regional lambda=0). No refractory, line-reset, opener, or family-persistence augmentation.

sources.name: r64_exact
sources.definition: Frozen G0 WorkingSetV2 + regional exact-token R64 source; distances 2..64; inherited fold source lambdas F0..F4 = .03,.03,.03,.02,.03.

sources.name: refractory_exact
sources.definition: Frozen G0 plus exact-token refractory source inherited from T0b: lag1 excluded; distances 2..5 weight 1; distances 6..64 weight .25; fixed rho=.04.

sources.name: line_reset_r64
sources.definition: Frozen G0 architecture with the regional exact R64 page cache reset at every physical line; no synthetic paragraph boundaries.

sources.name: family_persistence
sources.definition: Frozen G0 plus family-level page-cache source at lags 2..64 with fixed rho=.04, inherited from T0b.

unknown_controls.name: gross_page_shuffle
unknown_controls.definition: G0 text followed by within-page token permutation over fixed physical positions, preserving the page token multiset and line skeleton while destroying sequential dependence.

unknown_controls.name: gross_family_shuffle
unknown_controls.definition: Inherited T0b within-page×family permutation control, preserving page/family inventory while disturbing exact sequential organisation.

unknown_controls.name: line_opener_unknown
unknown_controls.definition: Frozen T0b training-only line-relative token opener source at pos0/pos1 with omega=.05; deliberately outside the memory-source class set.

target.name: Voynich canonical 34,087-event surface
target.open_policy: Only source_id_guard.check-target may release target statistics after all frozen qualification gates pass. A failed v1 requires a new assay version and fresh synthetic splits; no target result may be salvaged.

sampling_unit: independent manuscript-sized synthetic trial on the inherited five physical-bifolium skeleton folds; all five folds from one trial remain grouped in every split
physical_conditioning: Conditional on inherited page/line lengths, bifolium, section/hand metadata and token-position skeleton exactly as in T0/T0b. This is not an autonomous manuscript generator test.

feature_family.principle: Directional mechanism features, not the old omnibus 20-metric adequacy vector.
features: log2 exact-token recurrence excess versus within-page token-order permutation null at lag 1
log2 exact-token recurrence excess at lags 2-5
log2 exact-token recurrence excess at lags 6-16
log2 exact-token recurrence excess at lags 17-64
log2 same-family recurrence excess at lag 1
log2 same-family recurrence excess at lags 2-5
log2 same-family recurrence excess at lags 6-16
log2 same-family recurrence excess at lags 17-64
log2 ED1 recurrence excess at lag 1
log2 ED1 recurrence excess at lags 2-5
log2 ED1 recurrence excess at lags 6-16
log2 ED1 recurrence excess at lags 17-64
exact-token cross-line minus wholly-within-line recurrence excess
ED1 cross-line minus wholly-within-line recurrence excess
mean adjacent-page exact-token Jaccard
mean adjacent-page family Jaccard
within-bifolium page exact-token Jaccard minus cross-bifolium matched Jaccard
page new-type slope after token-count adjustment
held-out regional-model codelength gain: noregion minus full
held-out order codelength gain: noorder minus full
feature_family.sequential_null: 64 deterministic within-page token-order permutations per fold/trial, preserving page token multiset, physical line lengths and metadata skeleton; permutation seeds come from the assay namespace and never from target outcomes.
feature_family.standardisation: Training/development source data only, separately by physical fold. No target-derived centring or scaling.

classifier.family: per-fold multinomial logistic regression with L2 penalty; manuscript evidence is the sum of held-out fold log probabilities
classifier.selection: 5-fold group cross-validation on development trials only; all physical folds from a manuscript-sized trial remain in the same CV group

abstention.class_conditional_ood: Predicted class must also lie inside the 97.5% shrinkage-Mahalanobis envelope learned from development features for that class; otherwise abstain.

splits.development: 80 independent trials per named source, source-id seed namespace 410; used for feature normalisation, C selection, class envelopes and posterior calibration only
splits.calibration: 40 independent trials per named source, namespace 411; freezes posterior/margin/OOD thresholds if predeclared thresholds require monotone calibration, never feature or classifier redesign
splits.validation: 50 independent untouched trials per named source, namespace 412; primary source-identification gate
splits.controls: 50 independent trials per unknown control, namespace 413 with source-specific subnamespaces
splits.power_curves: After primary validation but before target: 40 trials/cell. refractory rho and family-persistence rho grids [.01,.02,.04,.06,.08]; R64 lambda scale grid [.005,.01,.02,.03,.04,.06]. These curves report minimum detectable strength and do not alter the primary classifier or thresholds.
splits.target: sealed until all primary source-ID, unknown-control, representation, leakage and power-reporting gates complete

pairwise_separation_statistic: For each unordered source pair, validation true-class-vs-alternative manuscript log-posterior margin. Effect is observed mean margin minus matched label-permutation null mean; null SD is from 999 trial-group label permutations of the frozen validation probability matrix. Report |effect|/null SD.
unknown_control_statistic: Frozen rejection/abstention indicator plus continuous OOD score. Effect is unknown-control mean OOD score minus known-source validation mean; null SD is the physical-trial SD of known-source validation OOD score. Both rejection rate and effect/nullSD gates must pass.

representations.name: R0_canonical_tokens
representations.definition: Canonical frozen token strings/families used by T0/T0b.

representations.name: R1_repeated_glyph_collapse
representations.definition: Deterministically collapse immediate repeated identical glyphs within each token before exact/ED1 feature calculation; family labels are recomputed from the transformed token by the frozen family rule.

representation_gate: Primary source-ID gates must pass independently under R0 and R1 with the same source definitions and classifier family. Hyperparameter selection is training-only within each representation. A disagreement is representation dependence and blocks target opening; representations are not averaged to rescue one another.

decision.mandatory_headline_below_2sd: THE METRIC DOES NOT RESOLVE THIS SOURCE PAIR

power_reporting.primary_summary: For each continuously parameterised source family, report the smallest prespecified strength achieving >=80% and >=90% correct source identification with Wilson intervals; do not interpolate a threshold not present in the frozen grid.
power_reporting.target_null_interpretation: If a qualified target assay later fails to identify a mechanism, exclude only mechanism strengths at or above the prospectively demonstrated detection frontier; weaker mechanisms remain unresolved.

leakage_assertions: Target events cannot be imported by development/calibration/validation/control runners.
All five physical folds from a synthetic manuscript trial remain grouped in model selection and evaluation.
Source labels, thresholds and feature definitions are frozen before validation outcomes.
Target representation is not selected after looking at target results.
No original-Voynich parameter rescue is permitted beyond the frozen source architectures and inherited conditional skeleton.
licensed_inference: If qualification passes and the target is later opened, the instrument may identify one of the five frozen recurrence/active-repertoire source architectures, or abstain, at the demonstrated source strengths and representations. A target class assignment is evidence of discrimination among these named source models only.
prohibited_inference: No conclusion about semantics, asemicity, hoaxing, historical authorship, motor origin, plaintext/cipher status, mechanisms outside the named source set, or autonomous manuscript generation. Failure to identify a class is not evidence that recurrence is absent below the demonstrated power frontier.
